headline: Alabama expands law limiting transgender athletes in sports to include colleges
snippet: Alabama among first states to extend trans athlete ban to colleges.

headline: Ivey signs bill setting new limits on Alabama's transgender student athletes
HRC condemns anti-transgender sports ban
snippet: Human Rights Campaign condemned as fourth anti-LGBTQ+ law in two years.

headline: Alabama House passes ban on transgender athletes in college sports
snippet: Passed 83-5, extending K-12 trans athlete ban to colleges.
